name: Young County, TX
findings: Young County has 64 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Young County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Young County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
